<script>
(function () {
  // One install per page, even if the tag fires twice.
  if (window.fs_lead_bridge) return;
  window.fs_lead_bridge = true;
  var dl = window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
  var push = function (name) { dl.push({event: name}); };
  // Forms that report their own success below must not also count at submit time (a failed validation
  // or a spam block would otherwise count as a lead). Search forms are never leads.
  var OWN = '.wpcf7-form, .hbspt-form, form[data-hs-forms-root], [role="search"], form[role="search"]';
  document.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    var f = e.target;
    if (!f || !f.closest || f.closest(OWN) || f.querySelector('input[type="search"]')) return;
    push('fs_form_submit');
  }, true);
  // Contact Form 7 fires this only after the mail was sent.
  document.addEventListener('wpcf7mailsent', function () { push('fs_form_submit'); }, false);
  // Any other page can post these messages, so only the site and the named integrations may count as leads.
  var TRUSTED = ['https://calendly.com', 'https://forms.hsforms.net'];
  // A sandboxed page reports the opaque origin "null", which every other sandboxed frame shares: never trust it.
  if (window.location.origin !== 'null') TRUSTED.push(window.location.origin);
  window.addEventListener('message', function (e) {
    var d = e.data;
    if (TRUSTED.indexOf(e.origin) < 0 || !d || typeof d !== 'object') return;
    if (d.type === 'hsFormCallback' && d.eventName === 'onFormSubmitted') push('fs_form_submit');
    if (d.event === 'calendly.event_scheduled') push('fs_booking');
  }, false);
  // Tidio: the first message a visitor sends starts the chat. The flag lasts for the tab's session, so a page
  // load does not recount it; where storage is blocked it falls back to once per page.
  var chat = false;
  document.addEventListener('tidioChat-messageFromVisitor', function () {
    if (chat) return;
    chat = true;
    try { if (window.sessionStorage.getItem('fs_chat_started')) return; window.sessionStorage.setItem('fs_chat_started', '1'); } catch (x) {}
    push('fs_chat_start');
  }, false);
})();
</script>
